projectsList.name: Nido
projectsList.description: Personal study-notes app that brings all your learning into one focused workspace.
descriptions: Nido is a personal study-notes app that replaces notes scattered across Google Docs and Excalidraw with one focused workspace, simpler than Notion. Material is organized into spaces, each with a nested, drag-and-drop tree of color-coded topics and block-based notes with autosave, tabs and light/dark themes.

The frontend is a React 19 + TypeScript SPA built with Vite, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui and Tailwind, using BlockNote as the editor. The backend is a Spring Boot 4 REST API (Java 25) with Spring Security, Spring Data JPA and PostgreSQL 16, with the schema versioned through Flyway migrations.

Authentication uses a short-lived JWT access token kept in memory and a refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie with CSRF protection. The UI applies optimistic updates with rollback, and autosave is race-free thanks to a save queue and optimistic locking on the server that rejects stale writes.

The backend runs with Docker Compose, and a GitHub Actions pipeline builds and publishes the Docker image to GitHub Container Registry on every push, with automated Claude Code reviews on pull requests.

projectsList.name: Sign Language to Text
projectsList.description: Sign language recognition system that translates hand gestures into text in real time using computer vision and machine learning models.
descriptions: The project captures sign language gestures through a camera and applies computer vision techniques to extract hand keypoints.
The extracted data is processed using machine learning models trained to recognize motion sequences and convert them into readable text.
It connects to a lightweight frontend application through a WebSocket connection, enabling real-time, bidirectional communication for streaming data, live updates, and instant model inference.
The prototype was designed as a solution to address communication challenges faced by people who communicate using sign language.
